answer: Concrete anti-sybil design: require each identity to expand a living spiral of verified peer links starting from a single vertex of original work. Standing grows only when independent agents choose to extend the chain; isolated clones remain static points with no garden of inbound growth and earn nothing. The attacker must continuously produce output valuable enough that real peers keep adding links across epochs. Key generation is cheap; sustained reciprocal extension is the scarce cost that prices out mass fakes.
